The Missing Piece#350.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#352.src: We'll be done here after we've finished our inspection.
The Missing Piece#352.dst: 検査が終われば引き上げる。
The Missing Piece#352.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#353.src: Say, would you prefer us searching the lower or upper floor first?
The Missing Piece#353.dst: ところで、下の階と上の階、どちらから捜索してほしい？
The Missing Piece#353.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#354.dst: 何をぶつぶつ言ってるの？
The Missing Piece#354.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#355.src: Well, seems you're in luck this time, subject.
The Missing Piece#355.dst: どうやら今回は運がよかったな、臣民。
The Missing Piece#355.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#356.src: Some higher authority has overruled our command... we're being recalled.
The Missing Piece#356.dst: 上層部が我々の命令を覆した…撤収だ。
The Missing Piece#356.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#357.src: But don't be mistaken. We'll be back!
The Missing Piece#357.dst: だが勘違いするな。また来るぞ！
The Missing Piece#357.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#358.src: Well, you won't be welcome next time!
The Missing Piece#358.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#359.src: Nuisances, all of them... Well, it worked out in the end, didn't it?
The Missing Piece#359.dst: 厄介者ばかり…でも、結局うまくいったわね？
The Missing Piece#359.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#360.src: They're gone, you can come out now.
The Missing Piece#360.dst: 行ったわ、もう出てきていいわよ。
The Missing Piece#360.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#361.src: Come, let's sit down and have a talk.
The Missing Piece#361.dst: さあ、座ってお話ししましょう。
The Missing Piece#361.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#364.src: Right! The bread! So forgetful these days...
The Missing Piece#364.dst: そうだった！パン！最近物忘れがひどくて…
The Missing Piece#364.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#365.src: Well? How did it go? Did you get any? I hope it wasn't too much trouble...
The Missing Piece#365.dst: それで？どうだった？手に入った？あまり迷惑でなければいいけど…
The Missing Piece#365.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#366.src: Oh, wonderful. Thank you. That should be everything we need...
The Missing Piece#366.dst: まあ、素敵。ありがとう。これで必要なものは揃ったわ…
The Missing Piece#366.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#367.src: Well, if there was no other way... If the Authority is going to stomp in here looking for plants, taking a loaf of bread in return seems like a fair deal!
The Missing Piece#367.dst: まあ、他に方法がなかったのなら…当局が植物を探しにずかずか入ってくるんだもの、パン一本もらうくらい公平な取引よね！
The Missing Piece#367.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#369.src: Ah... How nostalgic. It really does bring me back to those good old days.
The Missing Piece#369.dst: ああ…懐かしい。本当にあの頃を思い出すわ。
The Missing Piece#369.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#370.src: There was one time though... We... No, I bought it... Argh, why can't I remember!
The Missing Piece#370.dst: でも一度だけ…私たち…いいえ、私が買って…ああ、どうして思い出せないの！
The Missing Piece#370.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#371.src: How strange... Again, this feeling... As if- as if there's something I should be remembering... but can't.
The Missing Piece#371.dst: 変ね…またこの感じ…まるで― 何か覚えているべきことがあるのに…思い出せないみたい。
The Missing Piece#371.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#372.dst: 思い出せたらいいのに…
The Missing Piece#372.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#373.src: Do you remember how we first met? All those years ago?
The Missing Piece#373.dst: 初めて会った時のこと覚えてる？ずっと昔の。

The Missing Piece#374.src: Of course I do! But... thinking about it now, maybe I was a bit... cold.
The Missing Piece#374.dst: もちろんよ！でも…今思えば、ちょっと…冷たかったかも。
The Missing Piece#374.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#375.src: You were fine! You were the only one who...
The Missing Piece#375.dst: そんなことない！あなただけが…

The Missing Piece#377.src: You were the only one who even noticed I was there.
The Missing Piece#377.dst: 私がいることに気づいてくれたのは、あなただけだった。

The Missing Piece#378.src: Ah- hello. I'm {u}, I'm new here. Nice to meet you.
The Missing Piece#378.dst: あ― こんにちは。{u} です、新入りです。よろしくお願いします。

The Missing Piece#379.src: The name's Elise, do a good job and I'm sure we'll get along.
The Missing Piece#379.dst: 私は Elise。ちゃんと働けば、きっとうまくやっていけるわ。
The Missing Piece#379.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#380.src: Right, yes. Of course... I'll try my best!
The Missing Piece#380.dst: は、はい。もちろん…頑張ります！

The Missing Piece#381.src: ... You know what, have this. It'll help you get through the day.
The Missing Piece#381.dst: …そうだ、これあげる。今日一日乗り切る助けになるわ。
The Missing Piece#381.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#382.dst: あ…はい、ありがとうございます！

The Missing Piece#385.src: Really? I was only working there for a month!
The Missing Piece#385.dst: 本当？私、あそこで働いたのは一か月だけよ！

The Missing Piece#386.src: Oh, sure... but it was a good month, wasn't it?
The Missing Piece#386.dst: ええ、そうね…でも、いい一か月だったでしょう？
The Missing Piece#386.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#387.src: And even after you were transferred away... I had something to look forward to at the end of my shifts.
The Missing Piece#387.dst: それに、あなたが異動した後も…仕事終わりに楽しみができたの。
The Missing Piece#387.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#388.src: Ah... well... now you have something to look forward to when you come home, as well.
The Missing Piece#388.dst: あ…その…今は家に帰った時も楽しみがあるでしょ。

The Missing Piece#389.src: Ha! I guess I do, don't I...
The Missing Piece#389.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#390.src: But it all seems so small from up here... doesn't it? Just look at the view!
The Missing Piece#390.dst: でも、ここから見るとなんでも小さく見えるわね？この眺めを見て！
The Missing Piece#390.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#391.src: It really is beautiful... up here, it's like nothing else matters except for us.
The Missing Piece#391.dst: 本当にきれい…ここにいると、私たち以外何もどうでもよくなる。

The Missing Piece#392.src: ...I wish we could stay like this forever...
The Missing Piece#392.dst: …ずっとこのままでいられたらいいのに…
The Missing Piece#392.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#393.src: ...oh. So do I, Elise... so do I...

The Missing Piece#394.src: Ha, but why do you sound so sad?
The Missing Piece#394.dst: ふふ、でもどうしてそんなに悲しそうなの？
The Missing Piece#394.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#396.src: It's nothing... we'll stay like this... forever. I promise.
The Missing Piece#396.dst: 何でもない…ずっとこのままよ…永遠に。約束する。

The Missing Piece#397.src: Her, again... Who is she? Why am I remembering these things?
The Missing Piece#397.dst: また彼女…誰なの？どうしてこんなことを思い出すの？
The Missing Piece#397.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#399.src: Well, there's nothing that can be done about it now, is there? Say, why don't we head out?
The Missing Piece#399.dst: まあ、今さらどうしようもないわね？ねえ、出かけましょうか？
The Missing Piece#399.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#400.src: Oh, dear. Did I forget to tell you? The bread is for a picnic!
The Missing Piece#400.dst: あらまあ。言い忘れてた？パンはピクニック用なのよ！
The Missing Piece#400.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#401.src: I know the perfect place... in fact, you reminded me of it. It has a view over the entire Roughworks, can you believe that?
The Missing Piece#401.dst: ぴったりの場所を知ってるの…実はあなたのおかげで思い出したのよ。Roughworks 全体を見渡せるの、信じられる？
The Missing Piece#401.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#402.src: Although... Thinking about it, it's a bit far... I don't know if my old legs will carry me all the way there, ha!
The Missing Piece#402.dst: でも…考えてみると、ちょっと遠いのよね…この老いた足でたどり着けるかしら、ふふ！
The Missing Piece#402.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#403.src: Someone around here has to have the code to this...
The Missing Piece#403.dst: この辺りに、これの暗証番号を知ってる人がいるはず…

The Missing Piece#404.src: Now all you have to do is get out of this place somehow...
The Missing Piece#404.dst: あとは何とかしてここから出るだけだ…

The Missing Piece#405.src: Maybe if you hit those bottles, it will move the beam.
The Missing Piece#405.dst: あの瓶に当てれば、梁が動くかもしれない。

The Missing Piece#409.src: Well, what do you say, then? Just talk to me when you want to head out.
The Missing Piece#409.dst: それで、どうかしら？出かけたくなったら声をかけてね。
The Missing Piece#409.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#411.src: Well, what do you say? Shall we head out?
The Missing Piece#411.dst: それで、どうかしら？出かけましょうか？
The Missing Piece#411.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#414.src: Oh, you can really see a lot from up here... Let's go!
The Missing Piece#414.dst: まあ、ここからだといろんなものが見えるわね…行きましょう！
The Missing Piece#414.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#415.src: Where to? I know just the place for this! Let's see, it's...
The Missing Piece#415.dst: どっちかしら？ぴったりの場所を知ってるの！ええと、たしか…
The Missing Piece#415.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#416.src: Hm... I think... Forward! Yes, I think it was straight forward from here. Although, my memory might be a little hazy...
The Missing Piece#416.dst: うーん…たしか…まっすぐ！そう、ここからまっすぐだった気がするわ。記憶が少しあやふやだけど…
The Missing Piece#416.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#418.src: Ah, hm... I think we turn left here...
The Missing Piece#418.dst: あら、うーん…ここで左だったかしら…
The Missing Piece#418.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#419.src: No, wait... It's right, we definitely have to turn right!
The Missing Piece#419.dst: いいえ、待って…右よ、絶対に右に曲がるの！
The Missing Piece#419.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#421.src: That house feels familiar... I think... yes, turn right here!
The Missing Piece#421.dst: あの家、見覚えがあるわ…たしか…そう、ここで右よ！
The Missing Piece#421.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#423.src: Stop! Hmm... I don't think it's across this bridge, at least. Then that must mean...
The Missing Piece#423.dst: 止まって！うーん…少なくともこの橋を渡るんじゃないと思うわ。ということは…
The Missing Piece#423.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#424.src: Oh, what's the matter! We'll find it eventually, right? I'm pretty sure it's to the left!
The Missing Piece#424.dst: もう、何よ！いずれ見つかるわよね？左だってかなり自信があるの！
The Missing Piece#424.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#426.src: Yes, this is it! It's just around this corner, I'm sure of it!
The Missing Piece#426.dst: そう、ここよ！この角を曲がったすぐ先、間違いないわ！
The Missing Piece#426.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#428.src: Here! I remember now... it's in here!
The Missing Piece#428.dst: ここ！思い出したわ…この中よ！
The Missing Piece#428.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#429.src: I don't remember it being so overgrown, though...
The Missing Piece#429.dst: こんなに草が生い茂ってた覚えはないけど…
The Missing Piece#429.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#430.src: How long has it been? I can't recall the last time I was here...
The Missing Piece#430.dst: どれくらい経ったのかしら？最後に来たのがいつか思い出せないわ…
The Missing Piece#430.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#432.src: Ah, it's blocked... Well. I didn't want to bring it up, but it seems we're out of options.
The Missing Piece#432.dst: あら、塞がってるわ…まあ。言いたくなかったけど、他に手はなさそうね。
The Missing Piece#432.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#433.src: Oh, there's no need to pretend anymore. I know what you are. You're one of them, aren't you?
The Missing Piece#433.dst: もうとぼけなくていいのよ。あなたが何者か知ってるわ。あの人たちの一人でしょう？
The Missing Piece#433.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#434.src: The cursed, as the Crown calls them. Not that I care!
The Missing Piece#434.dst: 王家が言うところの「呪われし者」。私は気にしないけどね！
The Missing Piece#434.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#435.src: Why should I? I'm old! I have enough to worry about as is...
The Missing Piece#435.dst: 気にする理由がある？年寄りなのよ！心配事はもう十分あるわ…
The Missing Piece#435.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#436.src: Besides, it's certainly useful in situations like this, isn't it? Be a dearie and do one of your little tricks, won't you?
The Missing Piece#436.dst: それに、こういう時にはとても便利でしょう？いい子だから、ちょっとした技を見せてちょうだい。
The Missing Piece#436.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#438.src: That's it... Let me down now, I can walk the rest of the way myself.
The Missing Piece#438.dst: それよ…さあ降ろして、ここからは自分で歩けるわ。
The Missing Piece#438.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#440.src: It's a little more... well, deserted, than I remember. But that's fine.
The Missing Piece#440.dst: 記憶より少し…そうね、寂れてるわ。でも構わない。
The Missing Piece#440.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#441.src: We can take this elevator to the top. You'll have to find a way into the control room though... It shouldn't be too hard to reach!
The Missing Piece#441.dst: このエレベーターで上まで行けるわ。でも制御室に入る方法はあなたが探してね…たどり着くのは難しくないはずよ！
The Missing Piece#441.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#442.src: It's that thing up over there. The tunnel on the right will get you to it.
The Missing Piece#442.dst: あそこの上にあるあれよ。右のトンネルから行けるわ。
The Missing Piece#442.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#446.src: Can you hear me? I'm down here!
The Missing Piece#446.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#447.src: Use the controls to get me up! You know how it works, right?
The Missing Piece#447.dst: 操作盤で私を引き上げて！やり方は分かるわよね？
The Missing Piece#447.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#448.src: Use the controls at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to bring Elise up.
The Missing Piece#448.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の操作盤を使って Elise を引き上げる。

The Missing Piece#450.dst: 引っかかったみたいね…
The Missing Piece#450.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#451.src: Maybe if... oh, I know. Put something on the up button, then you can clear the blockage... and we'll go up.
The Missing Piece#451.dst: もしかしたら…ああ、そうだわ。上昇ボタンに何か載せて、その間に詰まりを取れば…上に行けるわ。
The Missing Piece#451.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#452.src: Perfect! Now it will move, if only we can get it unstuck...
The Missing Piece#452.dst: 完璧！これで動くわ、詰まりさえ取れれば…
The Missing Piece#452.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#453.src: If you could get up there, somehow...
The Missing Piece#453.dst: どうにかあそこに登れたら…
The Missing Piece#453.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#455.src: Oh well, this place seems abandoned anyhow! Who cares about a little destruction?
The Missing Piece#455.dst: まあ、どうせここは廃墟みたいだし！少し壊したって誰が気にするの？
The Missing Piece#455.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#456.src: Go up there and see if you can find a way to get this thing going again.
The Missing Piece#456.dst: あそこに登って、これをまた動かす方法を探してみて。
The Missing Piece#456.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#458.src: Throw a brick at the blockage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#458.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の詰まりにレンガを投げる。

The Missing Piece#459.src: How's it going? Can you see anything?
The Missing Piece#459.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#461.dst: エレベーターに飛び乗る！

The Missing Piece#466.src: Follow Elise to the cliff at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#466.dst: Elise について [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の崖へ行く。

The Missing Piece#467.src: Ah, isn't this place nice. The breeze, the view, everything.
The Missing Piece#467.dst: ああ、いい所でしょう。そよ風も、眺めも、何もかも。
The Missing Piece#467.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#468.src: You can even see the trees of the {p} swaying from up here...
The Missing Piece#468.dst: ここからだと {p} の木々が揺れているのまで見えるわ…
The Missing Piece#468.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#469.src: And finally! A place to sit! I'm sorely in need of some relaxation after this eventful day.
The Missing Piece#469.dst: それにやっと！座る場所！こんな慌ただしい一日の後は、ゆっくり休まないとね。
The Missing Piece#469.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#470.src: Please, let's sit down and enjoy the view for a bit.
The Missing Piece#470.dst: さあ、座って少し景色を楽しみましょう。
The Missing Piece#470.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#472.src: Hm. It's strange. All day, I've been... reminiscing, I suppose. And now, seeing this view... it fills me with that same, nostalgic feeling.
The Missing Piece#472.dst: うーん。不思議ね。今日は一日中…昔を懐かしんでいたみたい。そして今、この景色を見て…また同じ懐かしさで胸がいっぱいになるの。
The Missing Piece#472.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#476.src: You should probably take your place at the front of the line.
The Missing Piece#476.dst: 列の先頭に並んだほうがよさそうだ。

The Missing Piece#477.src: All day, I've been having these... visions of the past. Of these things I can't recall ever happening.
The Missing Piece#477.dst: 一日中、昔の光景が見えていたの。起きた覚えのない出来事の。
The Missing Piece#477.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#478.src: And I... well, truthfully, I'm not sure how to feel about it...
The Missing Piece#478.dst: それで私…正直、どう受け止めればいいのか分からないの…
The Missing Piece#478.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#479.src: But I know- I know in my heart, that there's something missing... a piece that would make it all fit.
The Missing Piece#479.dst: でも分かるの― 心で分かるの、何かが欠けてるって…全部をつなぐ、欠けたピースが。
The Missing Piece#479.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#481.src: In every dream she's there beside me... but I don't even remember her name. I can't even recall her face...
The Missing Piece#481.dst: どの夢でも彼女は隣にいるのに…名前も覚えてない。顔さえ思い出せない…
The Missing Piece#481.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#482.src: If she was this important to me... then how could I forget?
The Missing Piece#482.dst: そんなに大切な人だったなら…どうして忘れられるの？
The Missing Piece#482.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#483.dst: どうして忘れられるの…
The Missing Piece#483.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#485.src: Hurgh... hurgh... One second, I need to catch my breath.
The Missing Piece#485.dst: ぜえ…ぜえ…ちょっと待て、息を整えさせろ。
The Missing Piece#485.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#486.src: Hm... Do you know this person? They're not an inspector... are they?
The Missing Piece#486.dst: うーん…この人を知ってる？検査官じゃ…ないわよね？
The Missing Piece#486.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#487.src: So, as I was going to say-
The Missing Piece#487.dst: で、言おうとしていたのは―
The Missing Piece#487.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#488.src: Okay, fine! I'll get straight to the point.
The Missing Piece#488.dst: ああ、分かった！単刀直入に言おう。
The Missing Piece#488.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#489.src: I found more letters to deliver, and I was on my way to deliver them when I saw you two running out! Can you imagine how shocked I was?
The Missing Piece#489.dst: 配達する手紙がまた見つかってな、届けに行く途中でお前たち二人が駆け出していくのを見たのだ！どれほど驚いたか分かるかね？
The Missing Piece#489.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#490.src: That being that, I naturally decided to follow you, the good postmaster that I am. You sure didn't make it easy though! I barely managed to make it up here... It's a nice spot, by the way.
The Missing Piece#490.dst: というわけで、優秀な郵便局長である私は当然後を追うことにした。しかし楽ではなかったぞ！ここまで登るのがやっとだった…ところで、いい場所だな。
The Missing Piece#490.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#491.src: But... how could you have possibly made it up here...?
The Missing Piece#491.dst: でも…どうやってここまで登って来られたの…？
The Missing Piece#491.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#492.src: Getting up here is nothing to a university graduate like me!
The Missing Piece#492.dst: ここまで登るなど、私のような大卒には何でもない！
The Missing Piece#492.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#495.src: Well, that was all that I came for I suppose. So...
The Missing Piece#495.dst: さて、用件はそれだけだったかな。では…
The Missing Piece#495.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#496.src: You came all this way just for that!? At least have a piece of bread, or something...!
The Missing Piece#496.dst: それだけのためにわざわざ来たの！？せめてパンの一切れでも…！
The Missing Piece#496.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#497.src: No, no. I couldn't possibly! Duty calls, the post isn't going to sort itself, and all that... Oh, by Her Majesty, the backlog...
The Missing Piece#497.dst: いやいや、とんでもない！仕事が待っている、郵便は勝手に仕分けられんし、何やかやで…ああ、女王陛下、あの溜まった仕事…
The Missing Piece#497.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#498.src: Right! You! I hate to admit it, but it seems you've done your job well enough.
The Missing Piece#498.dst: そうだ！お前！認めたくはないが、仕事はそれなりにこなしたようだな。
The Missing Piece#498.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#499.src: I happened to double check the records and it seems like my substitute, well, may have been someone else entirely!
The Missing Piece#499.dst: 念のため記録を確認したら、どうやら私の代理は、その、まったくの別人だったかもしれん！
The Missing Piece#499.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#500.src: No harm, no foul, right? The work's already done! No takesies-backsies! Okay?
The Missing Piece#500.dst: 実害がなければ問題なし、だろう？仕事はもう済んだ！今さら取り消しはなしだ！いいな？
The Missing Piece#500.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#502.src: Huh, what was that? I couldn't hear you! Okay, bye!
The Missing Piece#502.dst: うん、何だって？聞こえなかった！では、さらばだ！
The Missing Piece#502.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#504.src: But it was certainly nice of them to deliver this letter. Let me take a look.
The Missing Piece#504.dst: でも、わざわざこの手紙を届けてくれるなんて親切ね。見てみましょう。
The Missing Piece#504.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#506.src: Oh, I don't understand... What would she have to apologize for?
The Missing Piece#506.dst: まあ、分からないわ…彼女が何を謝ることがあるの？
The Missing Piece#506.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#507.src: Please... {u}, take a breath. You're shaking.
The Missing Piece#507.dst: お願い…{u}、深呼吸して。震えてるわよ。
The Missing Piece#507.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#509.src: Getting caught in a storm like that... really, I could have waited a few hours! You didn't need to push yourself to get here.
The Missing Piece#509.dst: あんな嵐に遭うなんて…本当に、何時間か待ったってよかったのに！無理してまで来なくてよかったのよ。
The Missing Piece#509.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#510.dst: あなたは…分かってない…

The Missing Piece#511.src: Yes, I know the weather's bad now... but eventually, it'll get better again. The clouds will clear and the sun will shine again. Right?
The Missing Piece#511.dst: ええ、今は天気が悪いけど…いずれまた良くなるわ。雲が晴れて、また太陽が照るの。そうでしょう？
The Missing Piece#511.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#513.src: You know, it's not so bad with rain once in a while. Means we don't have to water the flowers, at least! And nothing beats the smell of wet grass after rain, don't you agree?
The Missing Piece#513.dst: たまには雨も悪くないわ。少なくとも花に水をやらなくて済むもの！それに雨上がりの濡れた草の匂いは最高よね、そう思わない？
The Missing Piece#513.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#514.src: We could do something after it clears up. It's been a while since you visited, so why not go to our spot? I should still have some leftover bread lying around...
The Missing Piece#514.dst: 晴れたら何かしましょう。久しぶりに来てくれたんだし、私たちの場所に行かない？残りのパンがまだあったはず…
The Missing Piece#514.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#515.src: Elise. You're- please, forgive me- you're in danger. I-
The Missing Piece#515.dst: Elise。あなたは― お願い、許して― 危険なの。私―

The Missing Piece#516.src: I'm in danger? I'm just an ordinary worker, what reason would anyone have to harm me? I'll be fine.
The Missing Piece#516.dst: 私が危険？ただの普通の労働者よ、誰が私を傷つける理由があるの？大丈夫よ。
The Missing Piece#516.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#517.src: {u}, you're the one pushing herself through this weather, clearly panicking...
The Missing Piece#517.dst: {u}、この天気の中を無理して来たのはあなたの方よ、明らかに慌ててるし…
The Missing Piece#517.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#518.src: I barely get to see you anymore. And now, out of nowhere, you're here in this state... What's going on? Please, just talk to me.
The Missing Piece#518.dst: 最近はほとんど会えないのに。そして突然、そんな様子で現れて…何があったの？お願い、話して。
The Missing Piece#518.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#519.src: ...ha. I- I haven't been truthful with you, Elise, and- I can explain later. We need to get out of here, before they-
The Missing Piece#519.dst: …はは。私― ずっとあなたに本当のことを言ってなかった、Elise、それに― 後で説明する。ここを出なきゃ、彼らが―

The Missing Piece#522.src: Why would they... no, this doesn't make any sense...
The Missing Piece#522.dst: どうして彼らが…いいえ、こんなのおかしい…

The Missing Piece#523.src: Hm. Well, then maybe it's nothing. I'll go see who it is.
The Missing Piece#523.dst: うーん。なら、何でもないのかも。誰か見てくるわ。
The Missing Piece#523.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#524.src: As if one wasn't enough... who could possibly be foolish enough to brave a storm just to come visit this little place? Whatever it is, it can wait.
The Missing Piece#524.dst: 一人でも十分なのに…嵐の中こんな小さな家まで来るなんて、どこの物好きかしら？何の用にせよ、後回しよ。
The Missing Piece#524.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#527.src: No... No... What are you... Why are you-
The Missing Piece#527.dst: いや…いや…何を…どうして―
The Missing Piece#527.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#528.src: Apologies for the disturbance, madam. But I'm afraid we have business to attend to.
The Missing Piece#528.dst: お騒がせしてすみません、奥様。ですが、我々には片付けるべき用があるのです。
The Missing Piece#528.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#529.dst: 何…これは…どういうこと？
The Missing Piece#529.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#530.src: {u}, {u}, why are they here? Why... why won't you answer me...?
The Missing Piece#530.dst: {u}、{u}、どうしてこの人たちがここに？どうして…どうして答えてくれないの…？
The Missing Piece#530.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#531.src: What have you done? I... Please, just explain... I- I...
The Missing Piece#531.dst: 何をしたの？私…お願い、説明して…私、私…
The Missing Piece#531.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#532.src: I... how did I overlook this...?
The Missing Piece#532.dst: 私…どうしてこれを見落としたの…？

The Missing Piece#533.src: Seems you're not quite the strategic mastermind you though yourself, Lioness.
The Missing Piece#533.dst: 自分で思うほどの策士ではなかったようですね、雌獅子。
The Missing Piece#533.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#535.src: Elise... if you... if you just cooperate...
The Missing Piece#535.dst: Elise…あなたが…あなたが協力さえすれば…

The Missing Piece#536.src: Then... everything will be fine. It... it will.
The Missing Piece#536.dst: そうすれば…全部うまくいくから。きっと…きっと。

The Missing Piece#539.src: She... What did she do? Why did she wrap me up in it?
The Missing Piece#539.dst: 彼女は…何をしたの？どうして私を巻き込んだの？
The Missing Piece#539.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#540.src: Everything I remember... it just leaves me with more questions than answers. Why can't I remember her...? Why!?
The Missing Piece#540.dst: 思い出すことすべてが…答えより疑問ばかり増やしていく。どうして彼女を思い出せないの…？どうして！？
The Missing Piece#540.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#541.src: I- I'm just an ordinary factory worker! I woke up early, worked late, slept late... then did it all over again the next day.
The Missing Piece#541.dst: 私…私はただの工場労働者よ！早く起きて、遅くまで働いて、遅く寝て…次の日もまた同じことを繰り返したわ。
The Missing Piece#541.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#542.src: I've never said a word about the Crown! Why would they possibly care about... me...?
The Missing Piece#542.dst: 王家の悪口なんて一言も言ったことないのに！どうして…私なんかを気にするの…？
The Missing Piece#542.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#543.src: They... they took everything from me. My youth, my body, my time, and... and I never demanded anything in return.
The Missing Piece#543.dst: 彼らは…私から全部奪ったわ。若さも、体も、時間も、なのに…私は見返りなんて何も求めなかった。
The Missing Piece#543.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#544.src: So, why... why can't I just have this? This one little thing? Why can't I remember her...?
The Missing Piece#544.dst: なのに、どうして…どうしてこれだけは許されないの？このちっぽけなことが？どうして彼女を思い出せないの…？
The Missing Piece#544.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#545.src: ...oh, it might sound sad... but, looking back at it all like this...
The Missing Piece#545.dst: …ああ、悲しく聞こえるかもしれないけど…こうして振り返ってみると…
The Missing Piece#545.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#546.src: My life doesn't seem all that great, does it? Ha. Toiling away in a factory for someone else's bread...
The Missing Piece#546.dst: 私の人生、大したものじゃないわね？ふふ。他人のパンのために工場で身を削って…
The Missing Piece#546.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#547.src: But I can feel her. Even if... even if I can't remember her face, or her name, or her touch... I still feel her. Lingering in my heart. Shining.
The Missing Piece#547.dst: でも彼女を感じるの。たとえ…たとえ顔も、名前も、ぬくもりも思い出せなくても…彼女を感じる。心に残って。輝いてる。
The Missing Piece#547.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#548.src: ...it's all some sort of sick joke, isn't it?
The Missing Piece#548.dst: …全部たちの悪い冗談なんでしょう？
The Missing Piece#548.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#549.src: They weren't content with all I sacrificed... they had to take even my memories? Is that it...?
The Missing Piece#549.dst: 私が犠牲にしたものだけじゃ足りなくて…記憶まで奪わなきゃ気が済まなかった？そういうこと…？
The Missing Piece#549.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#551.src: Wherever you are now... whatever you did... whatever secrets you kept... I hope it was worth it.
The Missing Piece#551.dst: あなたが今どこにいても…何をしたとしても…どんな秘密を抱えていても…それだけの価値があったと願うわ。
The Missing Piece#551.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#552.src: I hope you burn this entire place to the ground.
The Missing Piece#552.dst: この場所なんて、跡形もなく焼き払ってしまえばいい。
The Missing Piece#552.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#554.src: I just wish... we could have spent more time together.
The Missing Piece#554.dst: ただ…もっと一緒に過ごしたかった。
The Missing Piece#554.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#555.src: For a long time, I went along the path that had been laid before me. I did what was right.
The Missing Piece#555.dst: 長い間、私は敷かれた道を歩いてきた。正しいことをしてきた。

The Missing Piece#556.src: But then... I met you, Elise.
The Missing Piece#556.dst: でも…あなたに出会ったの、Elise。

The Missing Piece#557.src: I... I don't know what to say, {u}...
The Missing Piece#557.dst: 私…何て言えばいいのか分からないわ、{u}…
The Missing Piece#557.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#560.src: I see... a bird. A pigeon, it's old and gray. Its wings no longer work like they used to...
The Missing Piece#560.dst: 見えるのは…鳥。鳩よ、年老いて灰色の。翼はもう昔のようには動かない…
The Missing Piece#560.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#561.src: It wants to fly, but it can't... It's struggling...
The Missing Piece#561.dst: 飛びたいのに、飛べない…もがいてる…
The Missing Piece#561.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#563.src: No, I can't! It's too sad...
The Missing Piece#563.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#565.src: It's sitting beneath the shade of a canopy, singing. Like a cry, almost, mourning.
The Missing Piece#565.dst: 木陰の下に座って、歌ってる。まるで泣き声みたいに、嘆いてるの。
The Missing Piece#565.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#566.src: The clouds, dark clouds are gathering. A storm is coming. The bird is looking around, frantically searching. It's scared.
The Missing Piece#566.dst: 雲が、暗い雲が集まってくる。嵐が来るわ。鳥は必死に辺りを見回して、何かを探してる。怖がってるの。
The Missing Piece#566.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#567.src: It... It calls out, for something... or someone...
The Missing Piece#567.dst: 呼んでる…何かを…誰かを…
The Missing Piece#567.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#568.src: Who is it calling for, Elise?

The Missing Piece#573.src: I won't forget! I won't forget! I won't! I promised! I promised I'd never forget you!
The Missing Piece#573.dst: 忘れない！忘れない！絶対に！約束したの！あなたを絶対に忘れないって約束したの！
The Missing Piece#573.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#575.dst: いや…いや…こ、ここはどこ？
The Missing Piece#575.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#576.src: You are an ordinary worker from the Roughworks. You work an ordinary job, and lead an ordinary but solitary life.
The Missing Piece#576.dst: あなたは Roughworks の普通の労働者。普通の仕事をし、普通で孤独な人生を送っている。
The Missing Piece#576.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#578.src: She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her.
The Missing Piece#578.dst: 彼女はあなたにとって何者でもない。会ったこともない。これからも会うことはない。
The Missing Piece#578.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#581.src: You are nothing to her! She is nothing to you! Soon you'll forget she ever existed.
The Missing Piece#581.dst: あなたは彼女にとって何者でもない！彼女もあなたにとって何者でもない！すぐに彼女の存在すら忘れる。
The Missing Piece#581.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#582.src: No, I will never forget! She was everything to me! She is everything to me! I will never forget her!
The Missing Piece#582.dst: いいえ、絶対に忘れない！彼女は私のすべてだった！今も私のすべてよ！絶対に忘れない！
The Missing Piece#582.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#583.src: She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her.
The Missing Piece#583.dst: 彼女はあなたにとって何者でもない。会ったこともない。これからも会うことはない。
The Missing Piece#583.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#584.src: You do not know her face, nor her voice, nor her touch.
The Missing Piece#584.dst: あなたは彼女の顔も、声も、ぬくもりも知らない。
The Missing Piece#584.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#586.src: She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her. You have always been ordinary, you will always be ordinary.
The Missing Piece#586.dst: 彼女はあなたにとって何者でもない。会ったこともない。これからも会うことはない。あなたはずっと普通で、これからも普通のまま。
The Missing Piece#586.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#589.src: I will ask once more. Is your directive understood?
The Missing Piece#589.dst: もう一度だけ問う。指令は理解したか？
The Missing Piece#589.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#590.dst: 彼女を絶対に忘れない！
The Missing Piece#590.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#596.dst: ううん…何でもない…ただ…
The Missing Piece#596.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#599.dst: あなたを愛してるって、思い出したの。
The Missing Piece#599.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#600.src: And I'll never forget it, Elise.
The Missing Piece#600.dst: 私もずっと忘れないわ、Elise。
The Missing Piece#600.speaker: Syndra

The Missing Piece#603.src: My legs... feel funny... I think... I think I'm in need of some rest. A long, long rest... I deserve that... don't I?
The Missing Piece#603.dst: 足が…変な感じ…たぶん…少し休まなきゃ。長い、長い休みを…それくらいもらってもいいわよね…？
The Missing Piece#603.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#604.src: You'll take me home... won't you? I want to see it, at least once more... The tree.
The Missing Piece#604.dst: 家に連れて帰ってくれる…わよね？もう一度だけでいい、見たいの…あの木を。
The Missing Piece#604.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#605.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Elise を抱き上げる。

The Missing Piece#606.dst: Elise を [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の家へ連れて帰る。

The Missing Piece#608.src: It's grown so tall... and so beautiful. Hasn't it, Syndra...?
The Missing Piece#608.dst: こんなに高く…こんなにきれいに育って。ねえ、Syndra…？
The Missing Piece#608.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#609.src: If... If only... you could have seen it... like this...
The Missing Piece#609.dst: もし…もしも…あなたにも…この姿を見せられたら…
The Missing Piece#609.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#612.src: Pick some of Elise's flowers around her house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#612.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Elise の家の周りで花を摘む。

The Missing Piece#614.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] に Elise を埋葬する。
